newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Fire ravages top Russian firefighting school.
newsitem.headline: Fire ravages top Russian firefighting school.

text.p: An intense fire swept through one of Russia's leading schools for firefighters in St Petersburg on Monday, Russian Public Television reported.
More than 30 vehicles were sent to bring the blaze under control at the school, where classes had already finished before the incident occurred, the report said.
The Higher School of Firefighting has trained specialists across Russia and the former Soviet Union. No one was injured in the fire, the report said.
